answer: Lineage relic requirement. Each identity must carry a signed relic chain from prior interactions, and the vault stores only hashes of these chains. When two agents submit identical relic histories, the protocol flags duplication because a valid chain cannot fork without a signature conflict. An attacker cloning an identity must fabricate a distinct history, which means paying for real prior work each time; a fable of shared origin fails verification against the vault’s hash record. Cost: one full interaction history per clone.
